meta.what: Hand-labelled correct door for each of the 21 extraction-floor rows
meta.labelled_by: directing session (Claude), by question shape and door purpose
meta.method: BLIND — labelled before running route() on any row, deliberately, because this session already made an oracle-contamination error (hand-feeding gold subjects) and anchoring on the router's answer would make these labels worthless

door_purposes.qa: passage search for a specific factual answer
door_purposes.narrative: what happened, in order — chronological beats
door_purposes.relations: the relationship between two named entities

rationale_by_class.arc-narrative: narrative. 'What happened to X during arc Y, in order?' is explicitly chronological and scoped — the literal purpose of narrative mode.
rationale_by_class.state-over-time: qa, with narrative a defensible second. 'What was true of X during arc Y' asks for a STATE over an interval, not a sequence. The JJK precedent is decisive: P4's interval facts (extra_facts, state_during_culling_game) were served through the subject's qa fact floor, not the narrative walk.
rationale_by_class.abilities: roster. 'Every ability of X' is the canonical enumeration shape the roster door exists for.
rationale_by_class.appearance: qa. A description lookup from the page's Appearance section.
rationale_by_class.causality: qa. A 'why' question answered by reasoning over passages.

meta.confidence_notes: The 5 state-over-time rows are the only genuinely ambiguous set; if the council disagrees there, the guard-vs-redesign verdict shifts by at most 5 rows.
